Measuring Draft Strategy with Gini Coefficient¶

We can use Gini coefficient, which is used to quantify economic inequality, as a way of quantifying draft approaches. A higher Gini means more "stars and scrubs" strategy, while a lower Gini means more balanced spending.

Or, if we average by Owner.

Jason's team from above is the least unequal team. Meanwhile, Derek's team with the $80 CMC is the most.
